title: Oura sues rival Ultrahuman again, threatening its U.S. smart ring comeback
slides: Why is Oura suing Ultrahuman again?
Ultrahuman had planned a major U.S. comeback
But the new patent lawsuit might freeze those plans
U.S. buyers may wait longer for Ultrahuman rings
Check if your next smart ring faces delays
thread_text:
1. Oura sues Ultrahuman again

Oura has filed a new patent lawsuit against Ultrahuman, just as the latter planned a major U.S. comeback.

2. Ultrahuman's U.S. comeback frozen

The legal battle could delay Ultrahuman's plans to re-enter the U.S. market, leaving buyers in limbo.

3. Patent war escalates

This is the second lawsuit from Oura, signaling a tougher stance on patent infringement.

4. U.S. buyers face longer waits

Ultrahuman rings may not be available in the U.S. as soon as expected due to the lawsuit.

5. Check your smart ring order

If you pre-ordered an Ultrahuman ring, contact the company for updates on potential delays.
